column1: # undocumented_items.tsv — the API-DOCS missing-docs ratchet (RUSTDOC.3, decision_rust-native-tooling).
# One row per workspace crate directory under crates/, and one for xtask/ (XTASK.1): the number of public items rustdoc reports
# without documentation (`missing_docs`). scripts/check_rustdoc.sh re-derives every count on each
# commit and refuses a rise; a fall is refused too until the row is lowered to the new count, so the
# ratchet only tightens and this file always states the measured truth. Measured 2026-10-23 at f44947a;
# semulith-core 61 -> 0 when its generators documented the generated modules (RUSTDOC.4);
# semulith-dsp56300 120 -> 0 when its decoder, machine and loader items were documented (RUSTDOC.5).
